subject: Post-call exec recap: VanguardCare - Exec sponsor recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: James Park <james.park@vanguardcare.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@vanguardcare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call exec recap: VanguardCare - Exec sponsor recap & next steps

Hi James / Elena,

Thanks again for taking the time today - appreciated the candid discussion. Per our exec-level recap, below is a short summary of the key business outcomes, primary risks, and proposed procurement path so your leadership can align internally.

Summary of goals & outcomes
- Reduce clinical documentation turnaround time by ~40% for triage-notes and discharge summaries (current avg >24 hrs).
- Improve QA / auditability: consistent evidence trail for model outputs and fallback decisions.
- Maintain latency targets for real-time templates (<250ms p95) for clinician workflows.

Top pain points discussed
- Current vendor pipeline misses and long tail of model hallucinations causing rework.
- Data residency / logging retention constraints for PHI: need 7 years retention + customer-managed KMS.
- Procurement wants a clear SLA and escalation path for incidents that affect clinician-facing features.

Risk & ask summary (executive items)
- Risk: Logging/retention compliance - VanguardCare needs per-tenant immutable audit logs. Action: Laura to confirm logging config and retention guarantees.
- Risk: SOC 2 evidence and data processing controls. Action: Marissa to share SOC 2 summary and DPA.
- Procurement path: VanguardCare prefers a two-phase rollout (pilot -> production) with a single MSA + work orders. Procurement team indicated an internal approval target by 7/23.

Next steps (proposed timeline)
1) Marissa: Share SOC2 summary, DPA draft, and a brief risk matrix by EOD tomorrow. (attachment: VanguardCare_RiskMatrix.pdf)
2) Laura: Prepare initial MSA redline template and highlight any non-standard clauses for discussion.
3) Schedule: Technical deep-dive with engineering (request 60-90 min) + procurement meeting (contract terms) - propose dates: Wed 6/30 or Thu 7/1.

Let me know if I missed anything - happy to join a leadership sync next week to walk through the mutual action plan with your CIO/GC.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: VanguardCare_RiskMatrix.pdf (summary), MutualActionPlan.xlsx (template)

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, procurement@vanguardcare.com
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap: VanguardCare - Exec sponsor recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa - really helpful summary. A few quick notes from our side:

- Procurement confirmed the two-phase approach; target approval by 7/23 is what we are aiming for, but GC wants the DPA and SOC2 evidence before routing for signatures.
- On retention: GC flagged 7-year retention as non-negotiable for certain clinician notes. We need a written confirmation on per-tenant log retention and exportability.
- For the pilot, clinical ops wants a success definition: reduce rework by >=30% within 60 days. Can Redwood provide an instrumentation plan to measure this?

We can do the technical deep-dive on 6/30 (10:00-11:30 PT). Procurement would like to join the follow-up on 7/6 for contract items.

Thanks - James
James Park
CTO, VanguardCare
